claims.text: Ask: what they're proud of; something funny or wonderful the child did lately; the child's personality; child care needs; questions or concerns.
claims.quote: What are you most proud of since our last visit? (If the parent responds, “Nothing,” the clinician should be prepared with a compliment, such as, “You made time for this visit despite your busy schedule.”) • What is something funny or wonderful that your child has done lately? • How would you describe your child’s personality these days? • What things about your child are you most proud of? • What are your child care needs? • What questions or concerns do you have about your child?
claims.locator: 15 month visit, Health Supervision: History / Review of Systems

claims.text: Past medical hx: any specialty or emergency care since the last visit.
claims.quote: received any specialty or emergency care since the last visit?
claims.locator: 15 month visit, Health Supervision: History / Review of Systems

claims.text: Family hx: any new health condition or death in the family; if yes, who has or had it, age at onset and diagnosis, or age at death.
claims.quote: developed a new health condition or died? If the answer is Yes: Ascertain who in the family has or had the condition, and ask about the age of onset and diagnosis. If the person is no longer living, ask about the age at the time of death.
claims.locator: 15 month visit, Health Supervision: History / Review of Systems

claims.text: Social hx: what is most difficult, challenging and wonderful about being a parent; major changes or stresses since the last visit and their effect.
claims.quote: What do you find most difficult, challenging, and wonderful about being a parent? • What major changes or stresses have occurred in your family since your last visit? What is the effect of these changes on your family?
claims.locator: 15 month visit, Health Supervision: History / Review of Systems

claims.text: ROS — concerns about: head shape; crossed eyes; ears, nose and throat; breathing; vomiting or spitting, bowel movements; genitals or rectum; skin; development (muscle strength, movement of arms or legs, developmental concerns).
claims.quote: Do you have concern about your child’s • Head – Shape • Eyes – Cross-eyed • Ears, nose, and throat • Breathing • Stomach or abdomen – Vomiting or spitting – Bowel movements • Genitals or rectum • Skin • Development – Muscle strength, movement of arms or legs, any developmental concerns
claims.locator: 15 month visit, Health Supervision: History / Review of Systems
